title: A low point and breakdown
summary: A personal marital affair broke him, he lost heart and returned to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Did you reach any point in your career where you seemed to well be out of demand let's say or that you know, that there was less demand for you as a star than there had been? Well we have peaks and valleys, did you hit any real valleys?

I certainly did. Only it wasn't actually through my musicianship or playing. It was a personal wife affair thing you know that I just lost heart for playing. And sort of, well, I had more or less of a breakdown actually. I just didn't know what to do. I didn't know how to cope with the situation. And I didn't feel like playing and I didn't want to play and I didn't play. Consequently I didn't eat very well. A lot of friends helped me at that time.
And I finally went back to Chicago. This was about 1934, '35.
